planets.name: Kepler-411 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-411 with a 7.83-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-411 c was found in 2016 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-411. Its orbit and size follow Sun et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
